task_message:
Case L08: segment the lipomatous soft-tissue tumor on this T1-weighted MRI.

Volume: 301x301x372 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Finished. 

**Summary of the case (L08):**
- **Finding:** A large, well-circumscribed, fusiform lipomatous soft-tissue mass in the anterior/medial thigh compartment, mildly hyperintense on T1 (fat-containing with fibrous septa/entrapped muscle bundles), spanning ~20 cm craniocaudally and displacing the surrounding quadriceps.
- **Method:** Located the mass on axial/coronal/sagittal contact sheets, seeded the model with a positive point in the mass core, refined the boundary, trimmed over-inclusion with negative points, and verified the upper/lower ends in the final review.
- **Result:** Single connected component, 690.7 mL, extent axial 110–315, coronal 128–237, sagittal 81–211; all intensity-based candidate corrections were judged to be normal subcutaneous fat/fascial structures and rejected.
- **Confidence:** Medium (boundary follows the lesion capsule in all three planes, with some uncertainty about entrapped muscle at the heterogeneous periphery).
